newsitem.title: UK: Mercator atlas withdrawn from London auction.
newsitem.headline: Mercator atlas withdrawn from London auction.

text.p: A 16th century Atlas of Europe by Gerard Mercator, widely regarded as the father of modern map making, was withdrawn from sale at Sotheby's auction house on Tuesday after failing to reach its reserve price.
Sotheby's expected the atlas, a collection of 50 maps of Europe compiled by the Belgian cartographer, to fetch more than one million pounds ($1.68 million).
But bidding stopped at 760,000 pounds, a spokesman for the auction house said.
The atlas forms part of a collection belonging to the pension fund of formerly state-owned British Rail.
It is believed Mercator compiled the atlas as a guide for a European tour of a young German prince in 1570.
